finding.headline: "The 3am Sound"
finding.problem: "Every noise makes me jump. Is he breathing? Should I feed him again? My partner is snoring and I'm crying in the dark feeling like I'm failing already."
finding.person: Mother + partner, first night discharged from hospital, baby grunts and cries every 2 hours, both exhausted and panicking.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.
